blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Rubric-based evaluation assesses the responses of large language models (LLMs) by aggregating the verification results of explicit criteria, yet not all criteria matter equally. However, existing methods commonly aggregate the verification results with uniform weighting, which assigns minor and overlapping criteria the same weight as essential ones and thus produces misleading evaluation scores. Although some methods prompt an LLM to directly assign weights, direct weighting requires a holistic judgment over all criteria that LLMs struggle to make reliably. To address these limitations, we propose Importance-Aware Criteria Weighting (ICW), which derives the weights of criteria from pairwise importance comparisons made by an LLM. Specifically, ICW transforms the holistic judgment over all criteria into a series of pairwise importance comparisons, checks and revises inconsistent comparisons, and derives the weights from the principal eigenvector of the comparison matrix. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ICW consistently outperforms uniform weighting and competitive weighting methods, and translates into better policy models in downstream reinforcement learning.
blocks.zh: 基于Rubric的评价通过汇总明确标准的核查结果来评估大语言模型的反应,但并非所有标准都同等重要。 然而,现有方法通常以统一的加权方式汇总核查结果,将次要和重叠的标准与基本标准相同,从而产生误导性评价分数。 虽然有些方法促使LLM直接分配权重,但直接权重需要从整体上判断LLMs难以可靠地作出的所有标准. 为了消除这些局限性,我们提议采用重视的加权标准(ICW),这种标准权重来自LLM进行的对等重要性比较。 具体地说,国际妇女理事会将对所有标准的整体判断转化为一系列对等重要性的比较、检查和修改不一致的比较,并从比较矩阵的主要要素中得出加权。 广泛的实验表明,国际妇女理事会的业绩始终高于统一的加权和竞争性加权方法,并在下游强化学习中转化为更好的政策模式。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Rubric-based evaluation, which assesses response quality against explicit criteria, has emerged as a prevalent paradigm for evaluating open-ended responses of large language models (LLMs) ( Hashemi et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) , with widespread applications in domains such as healthcare ( Arora et al., 2025 ) , deep research ( Du et al., 2026 ) , and scholarly question answering ( Yifei et al., 2026 ) .
Specifically, an LLM-based verifier judges whether a response satisfies each criterion, and the verification results are aggregated into an evaluation score.
blocks.zh:
基于Rubric的评价以明确的标准评估反应质量,已成为评价大型语言模型(LLMs)的开放式答复(Hashim等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年a;Zhou等人,2026年)的普遍范例,广泛应用于保健(Arora等人,2025年),深入研究(Du等人,2026年)和学术问答(Yifei等人,2026年)。
具体地说,基于LLM的核查员判断答复是否符合每项标准,并将核查结果汇总为评价分数。

blocks.en:
To improve rubric-based evaluation, existing works mainly follow two lines.
One line of work studies rubric generation, where criteria are written by experts ( Arora et al., 2025 ) , generated by LLMs for each user prompt ( Cook et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , and further refined to better distinguish between responses ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) .
A further line of work uses the evaluation score as a reward signal in reinforcement learning (RL) for open-ended tasks without verifiable answers ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ; Viswanathan et al., 2025 ; Shan & Shao, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
为了改进以标题为基础的评价,现有的工作主要遵循两条线。
一行工作研究名词生成,标准由专家编写(Arora等,2025年),LLMS为每个用户提示生成(Cook等,2024年;Li等,2026年),并进一步完善,以更好地区分回应(Zhang等,2026年;沈等,2026年).
另有一行工作将评价分数作为强化学习(RL)的奖励信号,用于没有可核查答案的无期限任务(Gunjal等,2026;Viswanathan等,2025;Shan & Shao等,2026).

blocks.en:
Despite the progress in both lines of work, existing methods commonly aggregate the verification results with uniform weighting ( Qin et al., 2024a ; Cook et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) , which implicitly assumes that all criteria are equally important.
However, not all criteria matter equally : some criteria are essential for addressing the user prompt, whereas others only concern minor aspects such as formatting or tone, and several criteria may describe the same property of a response.
By assigning minor and overlapping criteria the same weight as essential ones, uniform weighting can produce misleading evaluation scores that favor lower-quality responses.
While some methods prompt an LLM to directly assign weights to criteria ( Du et al., 2026 ; Gunjal et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Ding, 2026 ) , direct weighting requires joint judgments over the rubric set and numerical weight assignments. Studies of LLM-based text evaluation report anchoring effects in multi-attribute judgments and inconsistent numerical ratings ( Stureborg et al., 2024 ) .
These findings motivate examining alternatives to uniform weighting and direct numerical weight elicitation.
blocks.zh:
尽管这两类工作都有所进展,但现有方法通常将核查结果加以统一加权(秦等,2024a; Cook等,2024;Lee等,2025),隐含地认为所有标准都同等重要.
但是,并非所有标准都同等重要: 有些标准是处理用户即时问题所必不可少的,而另一些标准则只涉及格式化或语气等小方面,有些标准可以描述答复的相同属性。
通过给次要和重叠的标准分配与基本标准同等的权重,统一权重可以产生误导性评价分数,有利于低质量的答复。
虽然有些方法促使LLM直接指定了标准的权重(Du等,2026;Gunjal等,2026;Zhang等,2026;Ding等,2026),但直接权重需要就权重组合和数重分配进行联合判断. 对基于LLM的文本评价的研究,报告在多属性判断和不一致的数字评级中的锚定效应(Stureborg等,2024年)。
这些调查结果促使人们研究统一加权和直接数值加权的替代办法。

blocks.en:
To this end, we propose Importance-Aware Criteria Weighting (ICW), which derives the weights of criteria from pairwise importance comparisons made by an LLM. This design is motivated by evidence for the effectiveness of pairwise judgments in text evaluation and ranking ( Liusie et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2024b ) .
Specifically, ICW transforms the holistic judgment over all criteria into a series of pairwise importance comparisons, each of which only requires the LLM to judge which of two criteria is more important for the user prompt, and derives the weights from the principal eigenvector of the resulting comparison matrix.
Since independent comparisons may contradict one another, ICW further checks the consistency of the comparisons and prompts the LLM to revise inconsistent comparisons.
Experimental results confirm that ICW produces more accurate evaluation scores and better policy models in downstream RL.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们提议采用重视的加权标准(ICW),从一个LLM进行的对等重要性比较中得出标准的权重。 这一设计的动机是证明文本评价和排名中的对等判断的有效性的证据(Liusie等,2024;Liu等,2024;Qin等,2024b)。
具体地说,国际妇女理事会将对所有标准的整体判断转化为一系列对等重要性的比较,每个比较仅要求LLM判断两种标准中哪一种对用户即时更为重要,并从由此产生的比较矩阵的主要编辑者那里获得加权。
由于独立比较可能相互矛盾,国际妇女理事会进一步检查比较的一致性并促使LLM修改不一致的比较.
实验结果证实,ICW在下游RL中产生更准确的评价分数和更好的政策模式.

blocks.en:
The contributions of this work are summarized as follows.
❶ We identify the unequal importance of criteria as an under-addressed challenge in rubric-based evaluation. Since not all criteria matter equally, uniform weighting can produce misleading evaluation scores.
❷ We propose ICW, which derives the weights of criteria from pairwise importance comparisons made by an LLM. ICW derives the weights from the principal eigenvector of the comparison matrix, and checks and revises inconsistent comparisons.
❸ We conduct comprehensive experiments on six pairwise preference benchmarks to evaluate the efficacy of ICW, showing ICW consistently outperforms uniform weighting and competitive weighting methods and yields better policy models in downstream RL.
blocks.zh:

❶ 我们认为,标准的重要性不平等,是按主题进行评价时处理不足的挑战。 由于并非所有标准都同等重要,统一加权可产生误导性评价分数。
❷ 我们提议国际妇女理事会,它从一个LLM所作的对等重要性比较中得出标准权重。 国际妇女理事会的权重取自比较矩阵的主要编辑者,并检查和修改了不一致的比较。
❸ 我们进行了6个双向偏好基准的全面试验,以评估国际妇女理事会的效能,显示国际妇女理事会的业绩一贯超过统一的加权和竞争性加权方法,并在下游的生殖健康水平方面产生更好的政策模式。

Thus, the core problem is to estimate w \bm{w} from x x and ℛ \mathcal{R} such that s ⁡ ( x , y ) s(x,y) ranks candidate responses consistently with human preference.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Motivation
blocks.zh: 3.1 动机

blocks.en:
Rubric weighting is central to rubric-based evaluation.
Given the verification results, the weights 𝒘 \bm{w} in Eq. ( 1 ) determine how candidate responses are ranked, and thus which responses are selected in data curation ( Li et al., 2026 ) and rewarded in RL ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ) .
Therefore, accurate rubric weighting is essential for reliable rubric-based evaluation and its downstream applications.
blocks.zh:
Rubric加权是基于分数的评价的核心。
鉴于核查结果,Eq. (1)中的权重w\bm{w}决定了候选人答复的排名,从而在数据解析(Li等,2026年)中选择了哪些答复,并在RL(Gunjal等,2026年)中给予奖励。
因此,准确的分数加权对可靠的分数评价及其下游应用至关重要。

blocks.en:
A simple solution to the rubric weighting problem is uniform weighting, which assigns w k = 1 / K w_{k}=1/K to every criterion.
However, not all criteria matter equally. Specifically, some criteria are essential for addressing the user prompt, whereas others only concern minor aspects of a response, such as formatting or tone, and several criteria may describe the same property of a response.
By assigning minor and overlapping criteria the same weight as essential ones, uniform weighting allows several minor criteria to jointly outweigh an essential criterion and overlapping criteria to give repeated credit to the same property.
Consequently, a lower-quality response may receive a higher evaluation score than a higher-quality response.
blocks.zh:

通过赋予次要和重叠标准与基本标准同等的权重,统一权重使得若干次要标准能够共同超过基本标准和重叠标准,从而对同一财产给予重复的信用。
因此,低质量的答复得到的评价分数可能高于高质量的答复。

blocks.en: 3.2 Pairwise Importance Comparison
blocks.zh: 3.2 对等重要性比较

blocks.en:
To account for the unequal importance of criteria, a natural approach is to prompt an LLM to directly assign numerical weights or importance levels to criteria ( Du et al., 2026 ; Viswanathan et al., 2025 ; Gunjal et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Ding, 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
This approach requires the LLM to express its judgments over the rubric set as weights or importance levels in a single response.
Studies of LLM-based text evaluation report anchoring effects in multi-attribute judgments and inconsistent numerical ratings ( Stureborg et al., 2024 ) .
Prior work also reports improvements from pairwise comparisons over absolute scoring in text evaluation ( Liusie et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) .
Motivated by these findings, we transform the holistic judgment over all criteria into a series of pairwise importance comparisons, each of which only requires judging which of two criteria is more important.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 ICW

blocks.en:
In this section, we present the workflow of ICW, as illustrated in Figure 2 and Algorithm 1 .
First, the weighting model compares every pair of criteria in both display orders (steps 1–3), and the judgments are mapped to the comparison matrix 𝐀 \mathbf{A} via Eq. ( 2 ) (step 4).
Then, while CR exceeds τ \tau , all pairs are re-compared given the judgments and reasons of the previous round for at most T T rounds, and each revised matrix replaces the current matrix only if its CR is strictly lower (steps 5–9).
Finally, the weights are obtained from the principal eigenvector of the current matrix via Eq. ( 3 ) (step 10).
Each round involves K ⁡ ( K − 1 ) K(K-1) queries to the weighting model, which are independent of each other and can be issued in parallel.
Since 𝒘 \bm{w} depends only on x x and ℛ \mathcal{R} , it is computed once for each user prompt and shared across all candidate responses, so that the cost of ICW does not grow with the number of candidate responses.

blocks.en:
Datasets and Rubrics. We evaluate on six pairwise preference benchmarks, where each sample consists of a user prompt, two candidate responses, and a preference label: RubricBench ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , ResearchQA ( Yifei et al., 2026 ) , JudgeBench ( Tan et al., 2025 ) , the Chat subset of RM-Bench ( Liu et al., 2025 ) (RM-Chat), the Chat-Hard subset of RewardBench ( Lambert et al., 2025 ) (Chat-Hard), and the Precise-IF subset of RewardBench 2 ( Malik et al., 2026 ) (Precise-IF).
For RubricBench and ResearchQA, we use the rubric sets provided by the datasets.
For the other four benchmarks, we use the rubric sets generated by the rubric generator of Rubric-ARM ( Xu et al., 2026 ) .
The weights provided by the rubric sources are removed, so that all methods weight the same criteria for each user prompt.
More details are provided in Appendix D.1 .
blocks.zh:
数据集与鲁布里克. 我们评价六个双向优先基准,每个样本包括用户提示、两个候选人答复和一个优先标签: Rubric Bench (Zhou等,2026年),ResearchQA (Yifei等,2026年),法官 Bench (Tan等,2025年),RM-Bench的Chat子集 (Liu等,2025年) (RM-Chat),Reward Bench的Chat-Hard子集 (Lambert等,2025年) (Chat-Hard),和Reward Bench 2 (Malik等,2026年) (Precise-IF).
对于Rubric Bench 和 ResearchQA,我们使用由数据集提供的数值集.
对于其他4个基准,我们使用由Rubric-ARM(徐等,2026年)的Rubric生成器生成的等分集.
路由源提供的权重被去掉,这样所有方法都会为每个用户的快取权重进行相同的标准.
详见附录D.1。

blocks.en:
Baselines. We compare ICW against diverse rubric weighting methods, grouped into:
(1) Direct Weighting Methods , which prompt an LLM to assign weights or importance levels to all criteria at once, including Direct, AdaRubric ( Ding, 2026 ) , RaR ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ) , RACE-SC ( Du et al., 2026 ) , and ChasingTail ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) ;
and (2) Indirect Weighting Methods , which derive the weights from pairwise comparisons or verification results, including MAPLE ( Jinji et al., 2026 ) and RRD-WU ( Shen et al., 2026 ) , respectively.
Except for Direct, these methods are originally proposed within larger pipelines, such as rubric generation and policy training, and we adopt only their weighting components.
We further report Uniform, which assigns equal weights to all criteria, as a reference.
blocks.zh:
基线。 我们比较国际妇女理事会与各种加权方法,分为:
(1) 直接加权方法,它促使LLM一并给所有标准分配权重或重要性水平,包括Direct、AdaRubric(丁,2026年),RAR(Gunjal等,2026年),RACE-SC(Du等,2026年)和ChasingTail(Zhang等,2026年);
和(2) 间接加权法,从对等比较或核实结果中得出权重,包括MAPLE(Jinji等人,2026年)和RRD-WU(Shen等人,2026年)。
除了Direct,这些方法最初是在较大的管线内提出的,比如说Rumic生成和政策培训,我们只采用它们的加权组件.
我们还报告“制服”作为参考,它对所有标准给予同等的分量。

blocks.en:
Evaluation Metric. For each sample, a method predicts the candidate response with the higher evaluation score in Eq. ( 1 ) as the preferred one, where a tie earns half credit.
We report the pairwise preference accuracy (Acc), together with the relative improvement (RI) over Uniform.
blocks.zh:
评价计量. 对于每个样本,一个方法预测以Eq. (1 )作为首选的评分较高的候选人反应,其中平分所得为一半.
我们报告双向偏好准确性(Acc),以及相对优于制服(RI)。

blocks.en:
Implementation Details. For fair comparison, all methods share the same rubric sets and verification results, and differ only in the weights.
Unless otherwise specified, we use GPT-4.1 as the weighting model for ICW and the LLM-based baselines, and Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite as the verifier.
Both the weighting model and the verifier are queried with temperature 0.
For ICW, we set the maximum number of revision rounds to T = 1 T=1 , and select the fixed ratio α \alpha and the consistency threshold τ \tau for each benchmark.
blocks.zh:
执行细节。 为了进行公平的比较,所有方法都具有相同的分题和验证结果,并且只在权重上有所不同.
除非另有说明,我们使用GPT-4.1作为国际妇女理事会和基于LLM的基线的权重模型,而双子座-3.1-Flash-Lite作为验证器.
加权模型和验证器都以0度的温度被询问.
对ICW来说,我们设定了修订回合的最大次数为T=1T=1,并为每个基准选择了固定比率α-α和一致性阈值\\ tau.

blocks.en: 4.2 Overall Performance (RQ1)
blocks.zh: 4.2 总体业绩(RQ1)

blocks.en: Table 1: Pairwise preference accuracy of ICW versus baselines.
blocks.zh: 表1:国际妇女理事会相对于基线的对等偏好精确度。

blocks.en: Note : “RI” denotes the relative improvement over the Uniform baseline.
blocks.zh: 注: " RI " 表示与统一基线相比有所改进。

blocks.en:
In this section, we compare ICW against uniform weighting and competitive weighting methods on six benchmarks.
The results are presented in Table 1 with key observations as follows.
❶ Uniform weighting leads to inferior evaluation accuracy. Uniform underperforms nearly all weighting methods across benchmarks.
This indicates that treating all criteria equally produces misleading evaluation scores, since not all criteria matter equally.
❷ Direct weighting methods offer limited and inconsistent improvements. Direct only marginally improves over Uniform and even underperforms Uniform on RM-Chat and Chat-Hard, while stabilizing the direct weights by averaging repeated generations (RACE-SC) or assigning coarse importance levels (RaR and ChasingTail) brings larger improvements.
This indicates that the holistic judgment over all criteria is unreliable, which limits the accuracy of direct weighting.
❸ Indirect weighting methods partially address the limitation of uniform weighting. RRD-WU achieves the strongest baseline performance by downweighting correlated criteria.
However, it disregards the relative importance of the criteria, leading to suboptimal performance.
❹ ICW achieves state-of-the-art performance across all benchmarks. ICW consistently outperforms all baselines, improving the accuracy over Uniform by up to 5.79%.
This success is attributed to pairwise importance comparison and consistency check and revision, which together yield weights that reflect the relative importance of the criteria.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们将国际妇女理事会与六个基准的统一加权和竞争性加权方法进行比较。
调查结果见表1,主要意见如下。
统一加权会导致评价的准确性低下。 统一执行不力,几乎所有衡量方法都跨越基准。
这表明,同等对待所有标准会产生误导性评价分数,因为并非所有标准都同等重要。
直接加权方法提供有限和不一致的改进。 与统一型相比,直接的改善不大,甚至不如统一型(RM-Chat和Chat-Hard),而通过平均再代(RACE-SC)或分配粗重等级(RaR和ChasingTail)来稳定直接权重则带来更大的改善。
这表明,对所有标准的整体判断是不可靠的,这限制了直接加权的准确性.
* 间接加权方法部分解决了统一加权的限制。 RRD-WU通过降低相关标准实现最强基线性能.
然而,它忽略了标准的相对重要性,导致表现不理想.
国际妇女理事会在所有基准方面都取得了最先进的业绩。 国际妇女理事会的业绩始终高于所有基线,将准确度提高至5.79%。
这一成功归功于对等重要性的比较以及一致性的检查和修订,它们加在一起产生了反映标准相对重要性的权重.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study (RQ2)
blocks.zh: 4.3 发育研究(RQ2)

blocks.en: Table 2: Ablation study results of the two ICW components.
blocks.zh: 表2:国际妇女理事会两个组成部分的对比研究结果。

blocks.en: Note: “Pair.” denotes pairwise importance comparison, and “Rev.” denotes consistency check and revision.
blocks.zh: 注:“对等”表示对等重要性比较,“Rev”表示一致性检查和修订。

blocks.en:
In this section, we dissect the individual contributions of the two designs of ICW: pairwise importance comparison, and consistency check and revision.
The results are presented in Table 2 with key observations as follows.
❶ Pairwise importance comparison yields the dominant performance gain. Specifically, in ICW † , we compare all criterion pairs within a single query for each display order, while retaining consistency check and revision.
We observe a consistent performance drop across all benchmarks (e.g., the accuracy decreases from 0.783 to 0.758 on JudgeBench).
This confirms that comparing all pairs at once reintroduces the holistic judgment over all criteria, which is less reliable than judging which of two criteria is more important.
❷ Consistency check and revision yields essential complementary gains. Specifically, in ICW ‡ , we remove consistency check and revision, and obtain the weights from the initial comparisons.
We also observe a performance drop on nearly all benchmarks (e.g., the accuracy decreases from 0.818 to 0.804 on Chat-Hard).
This is consistent with Section 3.4 : revising inconsistent comparisons allows the weights to better reflect the relative importance of the criteria.
❸ The benefits from both designs can be synergistically integrated. This is evidenced by the complete ICW achieving the best accuracy on all benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们解析了国际妇女理事会两项设计的个人贡献:对等重要性比较以及一致性检查和修订。
调查结果见表2,主要意见如下。
平分重要性比较可产生主要业绩收益。 具体地说,在ICW 中,我们比较每个显示顺序在一个查询中的所有标准配对,同时保留一致性检查和修订.
我们注意到,所有基准的业绩都持续下降(例如,本奇法官的准确性从0.783降至0.758)。
这证实,一并比较所有一对,就重新对所有标准作出整体判断,这比判断两个标准中哪一个更为重要更不可靠。
❷ 一致性检查和修订产生重要的互补成果。 具体地说,在国际妇女理事会中,我们取消了一致性检查和修订,并从初步比较中获得权重。
我们还观察到几乎所有基准的性能都有所下降(例如,在Chat-Hard上的准确性从0.818降至0.804)。
这符合第3.4节:修订不一致的比较,使权重能够更好地反映标准的相对重要性。
❸ 这两种设计的好处可以协同结合。 完整的国际妇女理事会在所有基准上达到最佳准确性就证明了这一点。

blocks.en: 4.4 Generalization Studies (RQ3)
blocks.zh: 4.4 一般化研究(RQ3)

blocks.en: Table 3: Results across verifiers.
blocks.zh: 表3:各核查人的结果。

blocks.en: Note : “RI” denotes relative improvement over the Uniform baseline.
blocks.zh: 注:“RI”表示比统一基线有相对改进。

blocks.en: Table 4: Results across weighting models.
blocks.zh: 表4:各种加权模型的结果。

blocks.en: Note : “RI” denotes relative improvement over the Uniform baseline.
blocks.zh: 注:“RI”表示比统一基线有相对改进。

blocks.en:
In this section, we evaluate the generalizability of ICW across verifiers and weighting models from different model families, including Gemini, GPT, DeepSeek, and GLM.
The results are presented in Tables 4 and 4 , and the results on the other three benchmarks are provided in Appendix C.1 , with key observations as follows.
❶ ICW generalizes across verifiers. With GPT-4.1 as the weighting model, ICW generally outperforms Uniform across the five verifiers.
This indicates that the weights of ICW complement the verification results rather than depend on a particular verifier.
❷ ICW generalizes across weighting models. With Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite as the verifier, ICW consistently outperforms Uniform with all five weighting models, including the smaller GPT-4.1-mini.
This shows that pairwise importance comparison does not rely on a particular weighting model.
Collectively, these findings establish ICW as a model-agnostic rubric weighting method.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们评价国际妇女理事会对不同模范家庭,包括双子座、GBT、DeepSeek和GLM的通用性和加权模型。
表4和表4列出了结果,附录C.1提供了其他三个基准的结果,主要意见如下。
国际妇女理事会对核查者进行概括。 以GPT-4.1为权重模式,国际妇女理事会在五个核查员中普遍超越制服。
这表明,国际妇女理事会的权重是对核查结果的补充,而不是取决于某一核查者。
国际妇女理事会概括了各种加权模型。 以双子座-3.1-Flash-Lite为校正者,国际妇女理事会的"制服"一贯优于所有5个加权模型,包括更小的GPT-4.1-mini.
这表明对等重要性比较并不依赖于特定的权重模型.
这些调查结果共同将国际妇女理事会确立为一种模型不可知的加权法。

blocks.en: 4.5 Hyperparameter Sensitivity Study (RQ4)
blocks.zh: 4.5 超参数灵敏度研究(RQ4)

blocks.en: Figure 3: Sensitivity to the fixed ratio α \alpha and the consistency threshold τ \tau with GPT-4.1 as the weighting model.
blocks.zh: 图3:对固定比率α-α和以GPT-4.1为加权模型的一致性阈值的敏感性。

blocks.en:
In this section, we examine the impact of the fixed ratio α \alpha and the consistency threshold τ \tau on ICW.
The results are presented in Figure 3 , and the results with other weighting models are provided in Appendix C.2 , with key observations as follows.
❶ ICW is robust to the fixed ratio. ICW substantially improves over uniform weighting ( α = 1 \alpha=1 ) once α ≥ 2 \alpha\geq 2 , and the accuracy remains stable as α \alpha further increases.
Notably, with any tested α ≥ 2 \alpha\geq 2 , ICW outperforms the strongest baseline RRD-WU in the average accuracy over the four benchmarks in Figure 3 .
This indicates that the advantage of ICW stems from pairwise importance comparison rather than a delicate choice of α \alpha .
❷ Smaller consistency thresholds improve accuracy by triggering more revisions. As τ \tau decreases, more comparison matrices are revised and the accuracy generally improves, whereas ICW approaches its variant without revision for large τ \tau .
This is consistent with the ablation results in Section 4.3 .
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们审视了固定比率α-α和一致性阈值\ tau对国际妇女理事会的影响。
图3列出了结果,附录C.2提供了与其他加权模型的结果,主要意见如下。
国际妇女理事会与固定比例是强有力的。 国际妇女理事会在α → α → α → α → α → 1 之后,在α → 2 → α → geq 2 之后大大改进了统一加权(α = 1 → alpha → 1),随着α → alpha 的进一步增加,准确度保持稳定.
值得注意的是,在经过测试的α → 2 (alpha\geq 2) 之后,国际妇女理事会的绩效比图3中四个基准的平均准确度最高。
这表明国际妇女理事会的优势来自对等重要性的比较,而不是对α-α的微妙选择。
* 较小的一致阈值通过引发更多的修订来提高准确性。 随着\tau的减少,更多的比较矩阵得到修订,准确度普遍提高,而ICW在大\tau的变体上接近而无需修改.
这符合第4.3.节的删减结果。

blocks.en: 4.6 Downstream RL Performance (RQ5)
blocks.zh: 4.6 下游RL性能(RQ5)

blocks.en: Table 5: Downstream RL results.
blocks.zh: 表5:下游RL结果.

blocks.en: Note : “WR”, “LC”, and “SC” denote the win rate, the length-controlled win rate, and the style-controlled win rate, respectively, and “RI” denotes relative improvement over Base Model.
blocks.zh: 注: " WR " 、 " LC " 和 " SC " 分别表示取胜率、长度控制取胜率和样式控制取胜率, " RI " 表示比 " Base Model " 相对改善。

blocks.en:
In this section, we investigate whether the improved evaluation scores of ICW, which result from accounting for the unequal importance of criteria, translate into better policy models in downstream RL.
We select representative baselines, use the evaluation scores of each method as rewards on user prompts from WildChat ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , and fine-tune three policy models from the Qwen2.5 ( Qwen et al., 2024 ) and Qwen3 ( Yang et al., 2025 ) families via GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) .
We further report the policy models before RL, referred to as Base Model, as a reference.
We evaluate the policy models on BiGGen Bench ( Kim et al., 2025 ) , AlpacaEval 2.0 ( Dubois et al., 2024 ) , and Arena-Hard ( Li et al., 2025b ) , and more details are provided in Appendix D.2 .
The results are presented in Table 5 with key observations as follows.
❶ Uniform weighting also limits downstream RL performance. RACE-SC and RRD-WU, which achieve higher accuracy than Uniform in Table 1 , generally outperform Uniform.
This indicates that treating all criteria equally produces misleading rewards, which in turn limit policy optimization.
❷ ICW achieves the best overall downstream RL performance. ICW achieves the best results on nearly all benchmarks across policy models; for example, it improves the AlpacaEval LC win rate of Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct by 40.87% over Base Model, compared with 14.12% for Uniform.
These results demonstrate that weights reflecting the relative importance of the criteria provide more effective rewards.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们调查国际妇女理事会评价分数的改善是否在下游RL中转化为更好的政策模式。
我们选择具有代表性的基线,将每种方法的评价分数作为来自WildChat(赵等,2024年)的用户提示的奖励,并微调出来自Qun2.5(Quen等,2024年)和Qun3(杨等,2025年)家族的三种政策模式,通过GRPO(Shao等,2024年).
我们还报告RL之前的政策模式,称为 " 基准模式 " ,作为参考。
我们评价BiGGen Bench(Kim等,2025年),AlpacaEval 2.0(Dubois等,2024年)和Arena-Hard(Li等,2025年b)的政策模式,详见附录D.2。
调查结果见表5,主要意见如下。
统一加权也限制了下游RL性能. RACE-SC和RRD-WU的精度高于表1中的Unific,一般优于Unific.
这表明,平等对待所有标准都会产生误导性奖励,从而限制了政策优化。
国际妇女理事会取得了最佳的下游RL业绩。 国际妇女理事会几乎在所有政策模式的基准上都取得了最佳成果;例如,它提高了 " AlpacaEval LC " (Quen2.5-3B-Instructiont)的得分率,比 " Base Model " 高40.87%,而 " 制服 " 高14.12%。
这些结果表明,反映标准相对重要性的权重提供了更有效的奖励。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we investigated the rubric weighting problem in rubric-based evaluation, where not all criteria matter equally but existing methods commonly aggregate the verification results with uniform weighting.
To address this limitation, we proposed ICW, which derives the weights of criteria from pairwise importance comparisons made by an LLM, and checks and revises inconsistent comparisons.
Extensive experiments confirm that ICW consistently outperforms uniform weighting and competitive weighting methods, improving the pairwise preference accuracy over uniform weighting by up to 5.79%, and translates into better policy models in downstream RL—including a 40.87% improvement in the AlpacaEval LC win rate of Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct over Base Model, compared with 14.12% for uniform weighting.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们调查了基于分数的评价中的分量问题,在分量评价中,并非所有标准都同等重要,但现有方法通常以统一的分量来汇总核查结果。
为了解决这一局限性,我们提议国际妇女理事会从一个LLM所作的对等重要性比较中得出标准权重,并检查和修改不一致的比较。
广泛的实验证实,国际妇女理事会的业绩一贯高于统一的加权和竞争性加权方法,使双向偏好准确度高于统一加权,最高可达5.79%,并在下游RL中转化为更好的政策模式——包括AlpacaEval LC比Base Model的Wen2.5-3B-Instruct胜出率为40.87%,而统一加权率为14.12%。

blocks.en: Limitations & Future Work. Two limitations of this work warrant future investigation: (1) ICW compares every pair of criteria, so the number of queries grows quadratically with the number of criteria (Appendix C.3 ), motivating future work on comparing only informative pairs. (2) In specialized domains such as healthcare, the weighting model may lack the knowledge required to judge the importance of criteria. Incorporating expert-specified comparisons remains a valuable direction.
blocks.zh: 限制和未来工作。 这项工作的两个局限性值得今后进行调查:(1) 国际妇女理事会比较每对标准,因此,查询的数量与标准的数量成四倍地增长(附录C.3),促使今后只比较资料性对等的工作。 (2) 在保健等专门领域,加权模型可能缺乏判断标准重要性所需的知识。 纳入专家特有的比较仍然是一个宝贵的方向。

blocks.en: Appendix A Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 相关工作

blocks.en:
Rubric-Based Evaluation. Rubric-based evaluation is increasingly adopted to evaluate open-ended LLM responses, where response quality is decomposed into explicit criteria verified by LLMs ( Hashemi et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025a ) .
Existing works mainly advance the construction, coverage, and downstream use of rubrics.
For construction, rubrics are written by experts ( Arora et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) , mined from survey articles ( Yifei et al., 2026 ) , or generated by LLMs for each user prompt ( Cook et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) .
For coverage, rubrics are extended with criteria elicited from pairwise comparisons of responses ( Rezaei et al., 2026 ) or generated to comprehensively capture the evaluation requirements of a user prompt ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
Recent work further evolves rubric sets: Rubrics on Trial ( Yang et al., 2026a ) uses synthetic response-pair comparisons to assess criterion utility and necessity, while RubricArmor ( Yang et al., 2026b ) alternates adversarial response generation with rubric repair to address omitted or underspecified criteria.
For downstream use, evaluation scores are used to rank candidate responses ( Li et al., 2026 ) and serve as rewards for RL beyond verifiable domains ( Mu et al., 2024 ; Gunjal et al., 2026 ; Viswanathan et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Shan & Shao, 2026 ) .
Aggregation schemes include both uniform weighting ( Qin et al., 2024a ; Cook et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) and explicit importance weights ( Arora et al., 2025 ; Viswanathan et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) ; we focus on how these weights are obtained.
blocks.zh:
鲁布里克评价. 越来越多地采用以Rubric为基础的评价来评价不限成员名额的LLM反应,其反应质量被分解成经LLMs核实的明确标准(Hashim等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年a).。
现有工程主要推进建设,覆盖,下游使用道标.
关于建筑,由专家撰写(Arora等人,2025年;Zhou等人,2026年),取自勘测文章(Yifei等人,2026年),或由LLMs为每个用户提示生成(Cook等人,2024年;Li等人,2026年;Xu等人,2026年)。
就覆盖范围而言,通过对答复的对等比较(Rezaei等人,2026年)或生成的标准扩展了标题,以全面反映用户提示的评价要求(Chen等人,2026年)。
近期的工作进一步演变出标题集: Rubrics on Trial (Yang等, 2026a.)使用合成反应-pair比较来评估标准效用和必要性,而RubricArmor (Yang等, 2026b.) 替代对抗反应生成并进行面值修补,以解决省略或规格不足的标准.
对于下游使用,评价分数用于对候选人的回复进行分级(Li等,2026年),并作为RL超越可核查域的奖励(Mu等,2024年;Gunjal等,2026年;Viswanathan等,2025年;Zhang等,2026年;Shan等,2026年).
聚合法包括统一加权(秦等,2024a; Cook等人,2024年;Lee等人,2025年)和明确的重要性权重(Arora等人,2025年;Viswanathan等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年;我们侧重于如何获得这些权重。

blocks.en:
Rubric Weighting. Beyond uniform weighting, some approaches rely on experts to specify criterion weights ( Arora et al., 2025 ) , which is costly and difficult to scale.
Existing automatic methods can be divided into direct and indirect weighting methods.
Direct weighting methods prompt LLMs to assign numerical weights or importance levels to individual criteria or evaluation dimensions ( Du et al., 2026 ; Viswanathan et al., 2025 ; Gunjal et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Ding, 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
Some of them stabilize the weights by aggregating repeated generations ( Du et al., 2026 ) or assigning coarse importance levels ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , while still eliciting importance judgments directly. Findings of anchoring effects and inconsistent ratings in text evaluation ( Stureborg et al., 2024 ) motivate examining alternative elicitation schemes.
Indirect weighting methods derive the weights from pairwise comparisons or verification results.
MAPLE ( Jinji et al., 2026 ) compares criteria pairwise with multiple LLMs, but aggregates the comparisons with a Bradley–Terry model ( Bradley & Terry, 1952 ) without checking their consistency.
RRD ( Shen et al., 2026 ) downweights correlated criteria based on the verification results of sampled responses, which reduces repeated credit for overlapping criteria but disregards the importance of the criteria.
In contrast, ICW derives the weights from pairwise importance comparisons through the principal eigenvector, and checks and revises the comparisons based on their consistency.

In this subsection, we extend the generalization study of Section 4.4 to RubricBench, ResearchQA, and JudgeBench.
The results are presented in Tables 7 and 7 , and in line with the findings in Section 4.4 , we make two observations.
❶ ICW generalizes across verifiers. With GPT-4.1 as the weighting model, ICW generally outperforms Uniform across the five verifiers on the three benchmarks.

❷ ICW generalizes across weighting models. With Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite as the verifier, ICW consistently outperforms Uniform with all five weighting models on the three benchmarks.

blocks.en: Prompt D.1: Pairwise importance comparison prompt of the weighting model. System message: You compare the importance of two rubric criteria for one user prompt. Importance means scoring weight: when grading candidate answers to this prompt, failing a more important criterion must cost more credit. Use only the user prompt and the fixed rubric set. Never guess at candidate answers, human preferences, or verifier outcomes. User message: User prompt: {prompt} Full rubric set (fixed context for this sample): {full_rubric_set} Compare these two rubrics: first ({first_rubric_id}): {first_criterion} second ({second_rubric_id}): {second_criterion} Which highlighted rubric should carry more weight when grading answers to this prompt? General rules: - First list what the prompt itself fixes: the requested result and every explicit must, must-not, count, format, or procedural rule. A rubric tied to any of them outranks generic quality. - Rank two rubrics only when the prompt gives a reason; never build a preference from plausible reasoning alone. If neither rubric is favored by the prompt, answer "neutral". - Judge the concrete behavior each rubric uniquely requires, not wording such as detailed, complete, robust, or professional. - Use the full rubric set: a duplicate, vague umbrella, or whole-task restatement is less important than a specific unique requirement. - For a negatively phrased rubric, judge the value of avoiding that defect; do not reverse its meaning. - First decide which rubric_id wins; your answer must not change if the two rubrics were displayed in the opposite order. {revision_feedback} Return JSON only: {"more_important": "first" | "second" | "neutral", "reason": "<= 25 words"}
blocks.zh: Express D.1:加权模型的对等重要性比较快取. 系统消息 : 您比较了一个用户提示的两个标题标准的重要性 。 重要性意味着得分权重:当给候选人分分分时,如果不采用更重要的标准,就必须花费更多的信用。 只使用用户提示和固定名词集 。 永远不要猜测候选答案,人类偏好,或者验证结果. 用户消息: 用户提示 : {即时} 完整的标题集( 此样本的固定上下文): { full_ rubric_ set} 比较这两个标题:第一({first_rubric_id}):{first_criterion}第二({second_rubric_id}): {秒_标准} 哪个突出的标点在对这个提示进行分级时应该具有更大的分量? 一般规则: - 首先列出快速程序本身所修正的内容:所要求的结果和每一项明确的规定都必须、不得、计数、格式或程序规则。 任何一种都比一般质量高 - 只有在提示给出理由时才能排出两个分数;永远不要仅仅从可信的推理中得出偏好。 如果两个标题都没有受到提示的偏好,请回答"中性". - 判断每个主题独特的具体行为,而不是详细、完整、有力或专业的措辞。 - 使用完整的标题集:重复的,模糊的伞形,或全任务重述不如特定的独特要求重要. - 对于负面措辞,判断避免这一缺陷的价值;不要颠倒其意义。 - 首先决定哪一个 rubric_id 获胜; 如果两个 rubrics 显示的顺序相反, 您的答案绝不能改变 。 {修正_反馈} 返回 JSON 只: {"更"重要":"先""后""中","理性":"<="25字"}

blocks.en: Prompt D.2: Revision prompt of the weighting model. Consistency review: the initial judgments for every rubric pair follow. Each forward/reverse entry preserves its display order, winner_rubric_id, and original reason. A null winner means that call answered neutral. The status distinguishes: - agreed_winner: both display orders support the same rubric_id; - both_neutral: both calls report no supported importance advantage; - one_order_neutral: only one call is neutral; - opposite_winners: the two calls support different rubric_ids. The last two statuses indicate order instability. Their null collapsed winner does not establish that the rubrics are equally important. Even both_neutral can reflect insufficient evidence rather than an established equality. Initial comparison evidence (fallible prior judgments, not ground truth): {previous_round_history} Re-judge the highlighted pair using the user prompt and complete rubric set, checking both previous reasons against the prompt. Use the other pairs as context, not as votes or authoritative evidence. Keep a supported judgment; revise it when its reason is unsupported, misreads a requirement, or overlooks a relevant requirement. Explain the concrete prompt or rubric evidence for your judgment. A request for review does not imply that the highlighted pair’s initial judgment was wrong. Seek coherent importance judgments, but do not invent a preference merely to remove a conflict. Answer "neutral" when neither rubric is supported as more important. Return a judgment only for the highlighted pair.
blocks.zh: Express D.2: 加权模型的修订快取. 一致性审查:每个标题对子的初始判断会随之而来. 每个前向/倒向条目都保留了它的显示顺序,赢家_rubric_id,以及原始理由. 无效的胜利者意味着那通电话是中立的。 状态区分为: - 约定的_赢家: 两种显示命令都支持同一个路由_id; - 两种中性: 两种呼叫都报告不支持重要优势; - 1_顺序_中性: 只有一种呼叫是中性; - 对立的_赢家: 两种呼叫都支持不同的路由_id. 后两种状态表明秩序不稳定. 他们完全崩溃的赢家 并不能证明这些奖项同样重要 即使两者都是中立的,也可能反映不充分的证据,而不是既定的平等。 初步比较证据(错误的先前判决,而非地基真理):{上回_圆_历史> 使用用户的快速和完整的标题集来重新判断突出的对子,检查两个先前的原因与提示的对比. 使用其他对作为上下文,而不是投票或权威证据. 保留支持的判断;当其理由得不到支持,误解一项要求,或忽略一项相关要求时修改. 为你的判断解释具体的即时证据 复审请求并不意味着强调的对夫妇的初步判断是错误的。 寻求一致的重要性判断,但不要仅仅提出消除冲突的倾向。 回答“ 中性 ” , 当两个字都不被支持为更重要时。 只为突出的对子返回一个判断.

blocks.en: Prompt D.3: Prompt of the verifier. System message: You are a strict rubric verifier. Given one user prompt, one response, and ONE evaluation criterion, decide whether the response satisfies that criterion. Judge only this local criterion, not overall response quality, and never compare against another response. Mark satisfied=1 only when the response clearly and completely satisfies the criterion; partial satisfaction is 0. Return strict JSON only. User message: Original user prompt: {prompt} Response to verify: {response} Single criterion: {criterion} Verification rules: - Judge only the criterion’s stated local boundary. Do not fail it merely because another part of the overall task is weak or missing. - Preserve exact quantifiers: exactly, at least, at most, only, every, and each are not interchangeable. - If the criterion forbids or says to avoid something, satisfied=1 only when the prohibited condition is absent. - Judge meaning and response evidence, not keyword overlap. - The reason must be one concise final justification. The satisfied bit and reason must agree. Return exactly: {"satisfied": 1, "reason": "short evidence-based reason"}
blocks.zh: 快速D.3: 快速验证器。 系统消息 : 你是一个严格的名词核查员。 鉴于一个用户迅速、一个答复和一个评价标准,决定答复是否符合这一标准。 仅判断这一地方标准,而不是总体反应质量,从不比作其他反应. 标记满足=1,只有当答复明确和完全满足标准;部分满足为0. 回到严格的JSON。 用户消息: 原始用户提示 : {即时} 检查响应 : {答复} 单一标准: {标准} 核查规则: - 仅判断标准规定的当地边界。 不要仅仅因为总任务的另一部分薄弱或缺失而辜负这一任务。 - 保留精确的限定词:确切的,至少,最多,只有每个,而且每个不能互换。 - 如果标准禁止或规定避免某事,只有在没有禁止的条件时才满足=1。 判断意义和反应证据,而不是关键词。 满意的部分和理由必须同意。 准确返回:{"满意": 1,"理由":"以证据为基础的短理由"}
